posts.text: Grateful to receive the George Leland Bach Teaching Award, chosen by vote of the graduating MBA class. Many thanks to the students of the Class of 2026 for the curiosity, energy, and great conversations you brought to the classroom.

Part-time MSBA student Annie Winkler sat down with me for the Tepper School to talk about what the program is actually like. I compared it to a decathlon: statistics, machine learning, programming, visualization, and the communication skills to make it land in a business context.
